mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 31 degrees and overcast near Verona City Hall under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election for all four Aldermanic Districts; interested candidates must return their forms to the City Clerk by 5:00 p.m. on January 5th.

There is plenty to do, including The Crafty Fair happening today at ART House 360, followed by Live Music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, and even more music tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly look back, on November 2nd, officers were dispatched to West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
The flavor of the day is the refreshing Mint Cookie, and you can pick up a scoop when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
